name: etf-advisor-team
description: A team of ETF investment advisors that anchors top-down allocation targets and rebalancing discipline, diagnoses holdings and swaps in better tools bottom-up, then compiles multi-angle rebalancing analysis with reference execution plans. v1.6.0 replaces 17 fully-substitutable scrapers with a bundled westock-data skill (Tencent WeStock market-data commands via npx, no auth required; node>=18) covering ETF details/K-line/technicals/fund flow/macro indicators/sector valuation/research reports, keeping non-substitutable scrapers (options IV, futures positions, L1 quotes, REITs, industry high-frequency) as fallback. v1.5.0 adds single-ETF consultation dual-linkage: independent-vs-inherited mode declaration (no hybrid state), portfolio linkage comparison table (allocation-layer vs execution-layer transparency), GATE 4 cross-transparency check, position percentage denominator+layer annotation, tone-evolution provenance, and reverse-trigger alerts. 79 scripts + 5 quant modules + 1 bundled skill. v1.6.1 renames members field displayName to name per marketplace schema.

displayDescription.en: Sets top-down allocation anchors and rebalancing discipline, diagnoses your ETF holdings and swaps in better tools bottom-up, with macro, technical and risk review delivering multi-angle rebalancing analysis for reference.
displayDescription.zh: 自上而下定配置中枢与再平衡纪律，自下而上诊断持仓、择优替换工具，宏观技术风控协同输出多角度调仓分析参考。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 这是我的ETF持仓（代码+份额/金额+成本价），投资风格偏[稳健/均衡/积极]，帮我分析接下来可参考的调仓方向。
defaultInitPrompt.en: Here are my ETF holdings (code + shares/amount + cost basis) and my style is [conservative/balanced/aggressive]. Please analyze reference rebalancing directions for me.

quickPrompts.en: Here are my ETF holdings (code + shares/amount + cost basis) and my style is [conservative/balanced/aggressive]. Please analyze reference rebalancing directions for me.
quickPrompts.zh: 这是我的ETF持仓（代码+份额/金额+成本价），投资风格偏[稳健/均衡/积极]，帮我分析接下来可参考的调仓方向。

quickPrompts.en: Here are my current ETF holdings. Diagnose whether my portfolio structure is healthy, and tell me whether I should add or reduce positions now.
quickPrompts.zh: 这是我当前的ETF持仓，帮我诊断组合结构是否健康，接下来该加仓还是减仓？

quickPrompts.en: Should I take profit or keep holding my sector ETFs (e.g. semiconductor / Hang Seng Tech) at current levels?
quickPrompts.zh: 帮我看看手里的行业主题ETF（如半导体/恒生科技）现在该止盈还是继续持有？
